description: A geometry library for engineering drawings and models, in two dimensions and in three. Points, vectors, lines, polylines, polygons, faces with holes, circles and oriented rectangles in the plane; points, planes, triangles, polygons, faces, solids, boxes, coordinate systems and transformations in space. Over both: distance, projection, containment, intersection, collision, parallelism, parametrization, merging, splitting, extending and trimming, offsetting, and boolean operations. It also reads, writes and edits DXF drawings with AutoCAD's names, carries the label placement that arranges drawing labels clear of each other and of blocked regions, and packs boxes such as drawing views onto sheets of paper. Every comparison is tolerance-aware, because coordinates that come out of a BIM model are never exact.
releaseNotes:
NEW IN 13.12.0

      A minor release: public types and members added, none removed or renamed (checked package against package with
      Microsoft's API compatibility tool). The library now reads and writes DWG by its own code.

      NEW, DWG (namespace GeometryHelper.Dwg)
      - DwgReader.Read gives the DxfDocument and DwgReader.Open the DxfDatabase of a DWG of AutoCAD 2000, 2004, 2007,
        2010, 2013 and 2018 (AC1015 to AC1032), from a path or a stream, as the DXF AutoCAD writes of it: tables,
        blocks, layouts and viewports, hatches, dimensions, leaders, multileaders, tables, images, wipeouts, OLE frames,
        multilines, regions and solids with their ACIS data, materials, visual styles and dynamic blocks. Every check
        sum is checked; a broken object is left out with a Warn line and the rest read.
      - DwgWriter.Write writes a DxfDatabase or a DxfDocument as a DWG of the same six versions, AC1032 where none is
        given, the same bytes for the same drawing. AutoCAD 2021 opens the test drawings written so, AUDIT finding no
        error.

      NEW, DXF: versions and repair
      - DxfDatabase.Save(path or stream, version) saves as R2000, R2004, R2007, R2010, R2013, R2018 or R12 (AC1009)
        as AutoCAD 2021's SaveAs does, and returns a sentence for each thing the version could not hold: a table is the
        INSERT of its block before R2007, a solid's ACIS data is turned between SAT and SAB.
      - DxfDatabase.Recover(path or stream, out DxfRepairReport) opens a damaged DXF as RECOVER does, and Audit(fix)
        checks an open one as AUDIT does, with DxfRepair and 26 kinds of DxfRepairKind: a drawing of 21.8 MB and
        36 112 entities reports "No errors found." in 0.25 s.

      NEW, DXF: more of AutoCAD's database
      - Tables: DxfTableStyle with its cell styles, new DxfTable(position, rows, columns, rowHeight, columnWidth),
        RecomputeTableBlock, cell states, cell styles, field codes and block cells of a cell.
      - UcsTable, ViewTable and ViewportTable of a DxfDatabase (the snap and grid of *Active); BindXref; page setups
        made in code (new DxfPlotSettings(), CopyFrom); layer overrides of a viewport set and removed.
      - Associative dimensions: DxfDimension.DimAssoc, SetDimAssoc and ReleaseDimAssoc, DxfDimAssoc, DxfOsnapPointRef.
      - Multileader styles set as well as read; multileader breaks (GetBreaks, SetBreaks, ExplodeBroken).
      - Multiline styles added, renamed and saved to .mln (DxfMlineStyleSettings), and DxfMlineBuilder to make and
        rebuild an MLINE.
      - Dynamic blocks: GetDynamicGrips, ResetBlock, the grip moves of a parameter and its visibility states.
      - Clips: DxfBlockReference.ClipTo and RemoveClip with DxfSpatialFilter, as XCLIP; DxfViewport.ClipTo a REGION.
      - Regions: DxfRegionShape.Create(outer, holes, tolerance) with its area, perimeter and loops,
        DxfUnknownEntity.CreateRegion and GetRegionShape.
      - DxfTolerance (feature control frames), DxfPdfUnderlay and DxfPdfDefinition, DxfDrawOrderTable,
        DxfWipeoutVariables, DxfReadOptions.SupportFolders.

      NEW, geometry, packing and arranging
      - SheetPacker.Pack takes groups of GeoPolygon2 as well as of GeoRectangle2, for views cut to a polygon: an L- or
        U-shaped view lets another stand in its notch. PackPlacement.ViewPolygon gives each polygon placed.
      - ArrangeItem.Rectangle sets labels along the long side of a part's rectangle in place of a Leader: a rectangle
        2 000 by 300, a label 100 by 40 and the default gap of 50 put the first rows 70 off its edges.
      - GeoSpline2, GeoSpline3 and the DXF reader take a degree up to 25, where they refused one past 10.

      CHANGED: results callers will see change
      - DxfColor's colours by index are AutoCAD 2021's, not ezdxf's: 197 of the 255 change (12 was 0xA50000 and is
        0xCC0000, 250 was black and is 0x333333), and DxfColor.ByLayer.ColorValue is 0xFFFFFF where it was 0.
      - A TOLERANCE read is a DxfTolerance, not a DxfUnknownEntity; WIPEOUTVARIABLES a DxfWipeoutVariables, not a
        DxfUnknownObject.
      - A DxfDimension property that sets a style variable writes the override even at the style's own value.
      - GetIntersections and TryIntersectWith of a triangle, polygon, face or plane with a GeoObb3 or GeoAabb3 flat on
        some axis read the box as its rectangle, segment or point, where they gave no points.
      - A member that has to build from a shape with a coordinate that is not finite throws InvalidOperationException,
        where it threw an ArgumentException about its own working.
      - GeoTransform2 and GeoTransform3.Mirror across a line or plane at 45 degrees give whole numbers for whole
        points: (0, 10) across y = x is (10, 0), not 9.999999999999998.
      - Arranger.Run is faster among many blocks, with the same results to the bit.

      FIXED
      - CollidesWith, DistanceTo and GetIntersections against a box flat on some axis threw "A box with a zero size on
        some axis has no faces to build"; they answer. A box thinner than the tolerance on two axes is read as its
        segment.
      - A shape with a coordinate that is not finite meets nothing, where 352 members gave points of NaN.
      - TryIntersectWith of a spline and a curve far smaller or larger takes under 5 ms, where some ran past 10 s.
      - DistanceTo of a GeoTriangle3 nearly on one line measures to its sides.
      - DIMJOGANG overrides are read and written in radians; DxfRadialDimensionLarge reads its points under
        AutoCAD's groups.

      Details in CHANGELOG.md.

      Earlier releases: https://github.com/nguyenthanguth/GeometryHelper/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
